paragraphs.chinese:
这一集就是全家人为了 Jay 的生日，努力坐上去夏威夷的飞机。问题是，他们连洛杉矶都还没离开，假期就已经快散架了。

Gloria 把整趟旅行都当成惊喜来准备。Jay 一直以为她要带自己两个人单独去 Maui 浪漫一周。结果 Claire、Phil、Mitchell、Cameron、所有孩子和 Lily 全都拖着行李出现了。Gloria 给每个人都买了票。

Jay 拼命装出很开心的样子。他真正想要的，其实只是跟 Gloria 两个人坐在泳池边，安安静静看一堆小说。现在 Cameron 安排了一堆活动，Manny 想探索小岛，全家甚至还准备给他搞一个生日表演。每听到一个新计划，Jay 的脸就更像死了一点。

Mitchell 和 Cameron 在到机场之前就已经吵起来了。那天早上 Mitchell 有一大堆事情要处理，Cameron 却坚持还要给 Lily 塞进一个 playdate，因为另一个婴儿据说在学前班圈子里“很有分量”。大部分行李都变成 Mitchell 在收，结果到了机场他才发现，自己的钱包忘在家里。没有身份证，他根本上不了飞机。

Phil 主动开车送他回去拿。这又制造了另一个问题，因为 Claire 特别怕坐飞机，本来一直指望 Phil 留在身边。她从来没有真的说过这句话，但在 Claire 看来，Phil 就应该自己知道。

Phil 和 Mitchell 往家赶的时候，Claire 和 Cameron 开始互相抱怨自己的伴侣。Claire 说 Phil 应该不用她开口，就知道她什么时候需要他。Cameron 说这想法太不讲道理了——然后下一秒自己又开始抱怨 Mitchell 明明应该知道早上自己需要帮忙收拾，虽然他同样从没开口问过。两个人这才发现，他们说的根本是同一件事。

Phil 和 Mitchell 回家的过程也乱成一团。他们走错路、被锁在屋外、翻窗进去，还触发了警报。好不容易拿到钱包，又一路冲回机场。

与此同时，Claire 对飞行越来越紧张，最后开始靠喝酒让自己冷静。Manny 又因为有另一个同名的 Manny Delgado 在禁飞名单上，被安检拦了下来。Gloria 越生气地替儿子辩护，现场反而越紧张。

Jay 也承认，现在的自己其实也开始怕坐飞机了，因为他比年轻时拥有更多“不想失去的东西”。不过真正让他郁闷的还是：Gloria 看起来安排了一整个家庭假期，却根本没给两个人留独处时间。

这时候安检人员发现 Jay 和 Manny 的返程日期不一样，Gloria 最后一个惊喜就这样被暴露了：全家只在夏威夷待六天，之后先回家，而 Jay 和 Gloria 会继续单独留下。

Jay 的心情瞬间好起来。Phil 和 Mitchell 也总算赶回机场，Manny 通过安检，而 Claire 已经醉到没那么怕飞机了。折腾这么久，全家竟然真的都上了飞机。
paragraphs.english:
This episode follows the entire family trying to get on a plane to Hawaii for Jay’s birthday. They haven’t even left Los Angeles yet, and the vacation is already falling apart.

Gloria has planned the whole trip as a surprise. Jay thinks she’s taking him to Maui for a romantic week alone. Then Claire, Phil, Mitchell, Cameron, all the kids, and Lily show up with luggage. Gloria has bought tickets for everybody.

Jay tries very hard to look happy. What he actually wanted was a quiet week by the pool with Gloria and a stack of novels. Instead, Cameron has planned activities, Manny wants to explore the island, and the family is preparing some kind of birthday performance. Every new detail makes Jay look a little more dead inside.

Mitchell and Cameron are already fighting before they reach the airport. Mitchell had a million things to do that morning, while Cameron insisted on squeezing in a playdate for Lily because the other baby is apparently important in the preschool world. Mitchell handles most of the packing and then realizes at the airport that he left his wallet at home. Without his ID, he can’t fly.

Phil offers to drive him back. That creates another problem because Claire is terrified of flying and was counting on Phil to stay with her. She never actually told him that, but in her mind he should have known.

While Phil and Mitchell race home, Claire and Cameron complain to each other about their partners. Claire says Phil should know when she needs him without being asked. Cameron tells her that’s ridiculous—then immediately complains that Mitchell should have known Cameron needed help packing even though Cameron never asked. They both realize they are making the exact same argument.

The trip home is a mess. Phil and Mitchell miss turns, get locked out of the house, climb through a window, and set off the alarm. They finally get the wallet and race back to the airport.

Meanwhile, Claire gets more nervous about the flight and starts drinking to calm herself down. Manny is stopped by security because another Manny Delgado is on a no-fly list, and Gloria’s angry attempt to defend him only makes the situation more intense.

Jay admits he’s nervous about flying too. He says he has a lot more to lose now than he used to. But what’s really bothering him is that Gloria seems to have planned an entire family vacation without any time for the two of them.

Then security notices that Jay and Manny have different return dates. That gives away Gloria’s final surprise: the rest of the family is flying home after six days, while Jay and Gloria are staying longer by themselves.

Jay’s mood changes instantly. Phil and Mitchell make it back, Manny gets through security, and Claire is drunk enough to stop worrying. Somehow, the whole family finally gets on the plane.
